name: ALL in sequence and regex context
desc: Successor union constrained by minimum coverage of every argument, rather than intersection; continuation and exactness at each endpoint; zero-width and nested constraints; arrays and Unicode regexes; mode and function boundaries; capture merging, nearest eligible endpoints, earliest substructures, and duplicate names.
